jobs.title: Technical Project Manager: Software & Data Platform
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
ANDECO is building a data platform for a federal customer. A subcontractor will do most of the engineering. ANDECO owns the program, accepts the deliverables, and maintains the platform after delivery. The Technical Project Manager makes sure the right work gets done on schedule. You will sit between ANDECO leadership and the subcontractor's engineers, track execution against milestones, test reported progress against working software, and keep leadership informed.

The initial requirements and milestones are already defined, so your early focus is execution: keeping the subcontractor on plan and catching problems early. As the platform matures, you will take a larger role in its design, writing user stories and building requirements for later phases. This is a technical role. You need enough depth to question engineering decisions, and the judgment to turn that detail into short assessments that nontechnical leaders can act on.

**Manage delivery against the plan**

* Track subcontractor work against the approved project plan, milestones, deliverables, and demonstration schedule, and hold the subcontractor to them.
* Maintain the schedule, risk register, and decision log. Catch schedule and cost slips early and bring leadership options before a problem becomes a surprise.
* Run change control so that changes to requirements, architecture, schedule, cost, or deliverables are surfaced, priced, and approved before work proceeds.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Program Analysts are responsible for providing professional support for programmatic and internal activities, including implementing, coordinating, and promoting project activities; identifying and responding to member and team needs; assessing policies and programs; and providing senior level administrative support, as needed. Program Analysts have a foundational understanding of public health principles and practices and familiarity in their designated area of work.

Program Analysts typically report to a Senior Program Analyst. Program Analysts can complete projects or components of large-scale projects/programs with moderate supervision. A Program Analyst has frequent contact with outside organizations, NACCHO members, or other NACCHO staff regarding project coordination, implementation, and promotion.

The Program Analyst will support the Environmental Health team at NACCHO. jobs.title: Engagement and Program Manager - Wealth / Asset Management
jobs.description:
*Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant or outsourcing company.*

**Deliver with focus. Scale with intent**

Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide large customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?  
  
At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement and Program Manager, you’ll lead the rollout of our SaaS platform for our largest customers, successfully onboarding them through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.  
  
This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

**What you will do**

* Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through to go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).
* Interrogate and determine how customer requirements are and describe how they can be addressed in the platform.
* Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.
* Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.
* Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).
* Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.
* Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.
* Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

**How you will work**

You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. The role is remote with travel 40% of the time – both to customer site and to our head-office in Copenhagen - expected as a minimum.

**What we're looking for**

* 7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.
* Experience in either wealth management, private banking and / or asset management is a pre-requisite experience.
* Comfortable being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.
* Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.
* Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.
* Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.
* ITIL Foundation, PMP, PRINCE2 Certification (or equivalent) would be beneficial but not required.

**Technical Fluency**

* You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.
* You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.
* You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

**What this role is not**

This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

**We can offer :**

* Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.
* A competitive salary and benefits package.
* A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).
* Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.

Business Process Manager

* **Europe** — Flexible location across European countries
* **America** — Flexible location across American countries

Join ABB Robotics as an Implementation Manager and drive the implementation and adoption of our global Quote-to-Order process and supporting digital solutions.

The role will work closely with country commercial organizations to understand their current ways of working, introduce the global Quote-to-Order process, identify gaps and local requirements, and support countries through the transition to the target process and tools. * **Facilitate workshops** to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
* **Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation** — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.

* **Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions**, including the **commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA**.
* **Act as the primary Quote-to-Order implementation contact** for your region’s countries, building trusted relationships with sales organizations and key stakeholders.

* **Define and execute country implementation** plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
* **Champion continuous improvement** post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

**What You Bring**

* Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
* Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.
* Experience with commercial processes integrated with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP environments is an advantage.

jobs.title: Assistant Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Salary: $33.65 per hour**

**SUMMARY**

The Community Safety Crisis and Incident Response Through Community-Led Engagement (C.I.R.C.L.E.) program is a 24/7 unarmed response program that deploys a team of mental health professionals and individuals with lived experience to address non-violent LAPD calls related to unhoused individuals experiencing crisis. Through this public health approach, the City is able to improve community safety and outcomes for Angelenos in need of social services and support. The goals of the program are to: (1) disrupt the reciprocal relationship between homelessness and the criminal justice system by promptly responding to diverted non-violent incidents related to persons experiencing homelessness (PEH); (2) de-escalate and stabilize incidents involving unhoused individuals; and (3) create enduring positive outcomes for those individuals through trauma informed rapport building, connections to services and resources, and case management.

The Assistant Program Manager provides direct support to the Program Manager to ensure the smooth functioning of program activities. The APM is responsible for partnering with the Program Manager to ensure 1.) CIRCLE Operations are running smoothly and ample coverage is scheduled 2.) CIRCLE teams have what they need and inventories of participant/staff supplies are continuously maintained 3.) creating, developing and maintaining policies and procedures to make sure the program is compliant and deliverable at optimal levels.

**This is a temporary, grant-funded, full-time, benefited position.**

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Manages scheduling, logistics, and deployment coordination for program teams.
* Provides coverage for Program Manager in Program Manager's absence
* Supports PM with data collection and reporting to track program goals and outcomes.
* Exercises independent decision-making in the absence of Program Manager regarding budget, scheduling, and de-escalation
* Performs office and administrative functions directly related to the management and operations of the CIRCLE program such as procurement, logistics, deployment and scheduling coordination and the design and implementation of program policies/procedures.
* Maintains financial records by processing invoices, tracking expenses, and assisting with reconciliations.
* Acts as administrative support for purchases, supply management, travel, and event coordination.
* Prepare meeting agendas, take minutes, and manage follow-up actions.
* Provide on-call administrative support as needed, including occasional nights and weekends.
* Perform other clerical and administrative duties to support program success.
* Other duties as assigned.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Supervisors must have one of the following qualifications:

  + A Bachelor’s Degree in social work, psychology, or a similar field and a least one year of job-related experience working with PEH or very vulnerable populations, preferably those living with mental illness and/or substance addictions; or
  + An Associate’s Degree in social work, psychology, or a similar field and a least two years of job-related experience working with PEH or very vulnerable populations, preferably those living with mental illness and/or substance addictions; or
  + A certification in substance abuse counseling by the California Association for Alcohol and Drug Educators (CAADE) or the California Consortium of Addiction Programs and Professionals (CCAPP) or Certified Peer Support Specialist or Certified Psychiatric Technician, or other mental health professional qualification agreed to by MOCS and at least one year of job-related experience working with PEH or very vulnerable populations, preferably those living with mental illness and/or substance addictions.

* 3 years of supervisor experience.
* Ability to work well with diverse staff and clientele including cultural, language, sexual identity, gender and other diversity considerations.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Residence within the Zones, zip codes, or Council Districts of the Pacific CIRCLE Zone per the below map: El Segundo, Westchester, Playa Del Rey, Playa Vista, Mar Vista, Venice, Palms.
* Advanced level of knowledge of the client population and their complex needs including homelessness, financial instability, medical and mental health, and substance abuse.
* Experience in a community-based setting serving ethnically diverse, low-income clients. Knowledge of community resources and experience in community settings.
* Ability to use computers/internet to look up information and enter relevant notes.
* Conflict resolution skills.
* Customer service orientation.
* Analytical ability and skills to handle and solve complex issues and problems.
* Computer knowledge/skills or ability to learn.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Language capability: Spanish

**Other Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities**

* Must possess a valid California Divers License.
* Driver must be 21+ with none of the following in the past 3 years: any 2-point convictions; or more than (2) moving violations; or more than (1) moving violation and (1) at-fault or a passenger handling accident.
* Successfully pass the background check.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Must be in good physical condition and capable of performing job duties requiring frequent use of the entire body including ability to stand, walk, climb stairs, sit, drive for extended periods of time, exit and enter vehicles throughout your work shift.

* Ability to use a computer, phone or office equipment for extended periods of time.

* Ability to successfully and efficiently complete tasks in an environment where background noise is present and interruptions may be constant.

* Must be able to lift a minimum of 35 lbs.

* With instruction, the ability to assist persons with disabilities and to help transfer a 180 lb person and lift wheel chair in and out of a car or van.

* Stand Constantly

We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

This role is responsible for performing complex trust operations and accounting activities, including account reconciliations, cash processing, trade settlements, disbursements, and trust account maintenance. Serving as a key resource for the team, the Trust Operations Specialist ensures the accuracy and integrity of transactions, supports audits and process improvements, provides guidance to less experienced staff, and helps maintain efficient day-to-day trust operations within a highly regulated environment.

* Lead or subject matter expert for the department or function providing backup support in all. Functional areas within the department
* Performs complex accounting functions related to trust accounts including cash receipts, cash disbursements, income collection, trade settlement and control of the trust accounting system.

Position Overview:

**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for an experienced **Business Analyst – Procure-to-Pay** to help drive the transformation, standardization and continuous improvement of our end-to-end P2P processes and supporting systems.

**Your Mission**
================

As part of the **Finance Technology** team, you will act as a **business partner to Procurement, Finance and Business stakeholders**, with the ability to understand the underlying business objective, challenge existing ways of working, identify opportunities for simplification and automation, and translate business needs into efficient, scalable processes and system solutions.

Your role covers the **end-to-end P2P landscape**, from sourcing and contract lifecycle management through purchase requisitions, purchase orders, supplier invoicing, expense management, approvals, accruals and payment readiness, across applications including Workday Financials, Workday Procurement, Concur and CLM.

You will work at the **intersection of Business, Finance and IS**, ensuring that technology enables the right business processes rather than simply reproducing existing ways of working.

**We are not looking for a purely technical application specialist**. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Procure-to-Pay, Procurement and Finance transformation, ERP or business applications, combined with the ability to understand and navigate a complex multi-system environment. Knowledge of Workday Procurement, Concur or CLM is a strong advantage, but a strong P2P / Finance Systems profile with experience on other ERP or enterprise platforms will also be considered.

Responsibilities:

* **Act as a Business Partner for Procure-to-Pay**

* Develop a strong understanding of the company's business model, Procurement and Finance processes and end-to-end P2P operating model.
* Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal and Business stakeholders to understand their objectives, challenges and pain points.
* **Challenge existing processes, requirements and assumptions**, rather than simply translating them into system specifications.
* Ask the right questions to distinguish between a genuine business need, an existing practice and a historical system limitation.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate and improve processes across purchasing, supplier invoice management, expenses and contract lifecycle management.
* Recommend pragmatic solutions that balance business value, user experience, scalability, compliance and technical constraints.
* Help stakeholders move from a **“what we do today”** mindset to a **“what should the target process be?”**

* **Own P2P Process Analysis & Design**

* Map and document current-state and target-state P2P processes.
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, manual activities, controls and risks.
* Define clear process ownership, responsibilities and hand-offs between Procurement, Finance, Legal, Business teams and IS.
* Design target processes in collaboration with Procurement, Finance and Business stakeholders.
* Ensure consistency and appropriate standardization across countries, entities and business units.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process simplification across requisitioning, approvals, receiving, invoicing, expenses and contract management.
* Contribute to the evolution of the Finance Technology operating model and P2P roadmap.
* **Translate Business Needs into Effective Solutions**

* Lead functional analysis from business problem to solution.
* Gather business needs, but **challenge and refine them before translating them into requirements**.
* Define business rules, functional requirements, data requirements, approval rules, controls and acceptance criteria.
* Assess alternative solutions and make recommendations to stakeholders.
* Work closely with IS architects, application owners and integration teams to validate solution feasibility.
* Ensure that proposed solutions address the **end-to-end business process**, rather than optimizing a single application in isolation.
* Assess upstream and downstream impacts before changes are implemented, including procurement operations, accounting, supplier management, compliance and reporting.
* **Own the End-to-End P2P Systems Perspective**
* The role will cover the interaction between the key applications supporting P2P, including:

**CLM Workday Procurement Concur Workday Financials**

* The candidate will:
  + Understand how business processes and data flow across the application landscape.
  + Identify dependencies and impacts between applications.
  + Define functional requirements for system changes and integrations.
  + Work with IS Integration teams to ensure consistent end-to-end data flows.
  + Challenge solutions that create unnecessary manual work, compliance risk or downstream accounting impacts.
  + Identify opportunities to eliminate duplicate data entry and improve automation across contracts, requisitions, purchase orders, invoices and expenses.
  + Contribute to the definition of data ownership and business rules across the P2P landscape.
* The candidate is **not expected to be an expert in every application**. Instead, we are looking for someone who can quickly understand new systems, connect them to the underlying business process and identify the implications of changes across the landscape.
* **Drive Functional Delivery**

* Act as the functional lead for P2P initiatives and projects.
* Coordinate activities across Procurement, Finance, Legal, Business, IS and external partners.
* Translate business objectives into actionable functional deliverables.
* Contribute to project planning, prioritization and roadmap definition.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions requiring stakeholder attention.
* Ensure that functional decisions are properly documented and communicated.
* Follow initiatives through from initial business problem to implementation and stabilization.

Acteur de référence de la gestion et de la valorisation des déchets, la DSE évolue dans un marché en pleine transformation, marqué par les évolutions réglementaires, la montée en puissance de l’économie circulaire, la consolidation du secteur et l’évolution des attentes des clients. Pour éclairer ses décisions et soutenir sa conquête de nouvelles parts de marché, l’entreprise crée une équipe Market Intelligence.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Agent Safety & Security
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead high priority safety and security programs which advance defense in depth for agents, which we have written about publicly.

You will be the lead TPM coordinating work across teams to strengthen how we develop and deploy agents safely and securely, and to bring what we build internally to customers and partners so everyone has the tools to safely and securely use Claude. You will be responsible for leading meetings with executives and technical leads, maintaining complex project plans, identifying and addressing risks, developing metrics, and communicating to the company and our customers about this work.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Maintain the roadmap** - Maintain and extend the existing roadmap for all work contributing to this effort across the company and implement approaches to ensure accuracy and relevance amidst a fast operational tempo.
* **Turn program goals into measurable exit criteria at each phase of the work** - To do this well you’ll need to be responsive to new developments in capabilities and the threat landscape, both of which are evolving fast. Maintain key metrics and dashboards.
* **Run the operating rhythm** - Chair the leads meetings, working group meetings, design reviews, and executive check-ins. Record decisions and actions, disseminate sitreps quickly and regularly, and follow up until open issues close.
* **Lead executive and contributor communication** - Drive conversations, write regular reports, contribute to design documents, and produce decisional documents as needed. Say plainly what is on track, what is not, and where help is needed.
* **Maintain the risk register** - Track risks, exceptions, and risk acceptances in one place and bring hard calls to the right decision maker.
* **Drive company-wide communications** - Partner with internal communications on progress updates and on rollouts that change how employees work with Claude every day.
* **Lead through other TPMs** - Coordinate subject matter specific TPMs and engineering managers who do not report to you. Set shared standards, spot coverage gaps, and step in to augment capacity where needed.
* **Take coordination load off technical leaders** - Find owners for cross-team problems, frame tradeoffs across Security, Safeguards, Research, Privacy, Legal, and Product, manage staffing tasks, and organize exercises that test our controls.
* **Maintain industry context** - Track relevant incidents, capabilities shifts, and research across frontier labs, and understand the key risks they reveal. Bring those lessons into our threat model, roadmap, and risk register.

**You may be a good fit if you:**
---------------------------------

* Have led company-wide technical programs, especially a company-wide security program, with multiple workstreams, executive sponsors, and other program managers rolling up to you.
* Have a strong background in at least one of the program's domains: agent or infrastructure security, ML classifiers and monitoring, evaluations, inference infrastructure, protecting an organization’s most sensitive data, or shipping security controls to customers. You know the terminology and can ramp up on the rest quickly.
* Have worked closely with ML research teams and understand how models are trained and evaluated.
* Work independently. You set direction without waiting for instructions and know when to make decisions and when to escalate.
* Can command a room and hold senior engineers, researchers, and executives accountable without formal authority.
* Write clearly and fast for any audience, from a one-page executive brief to a company-wide announcement.
* Use AI tools like Claude to automate tracking, reporting, and follow-up.
* Care about AI safety and want to help keep powerful systems under human oversight.

* Have 10+ years of experience in one of the aforementioned areas.

**Deadline to apply:** None, applications will be received on a rolling basis.

**Annual Salary:** TBD with Recruiting.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$365,000 - $435,000 USD

-------------

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

The Cybersecurity Operations Analyst is responsible for supporting and advancing THINK Surgical's cybersecurity program through a combination of security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, cybersecurity projects, compliance activities, AI governance initiatives, and data governance programs.

This role serves as a key contributor to the organization's overall cybersecurity and information protection strategy, helping secure systems, cloud services, endpoints, data, and emerging technologies while continuously improving cybersecurity maturity across the organization.

Approximately 60% of the role is focused on cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, incident response, compliance support, and security administration. Approximately 40% of the role is focused on cybersecurity projects, AI governance, data governance initiatives, and continuous security improvement efforts.

The successful candidate will investigate security events, coordinate remediation efforts, support data protection initiatives, contribute to AI governance activities, and lead security improvement projects in collaboration with IT, Engineering, Quality, Compliance, and business stakeholders. This position is based at THINK’s corporate office.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Security Operations & Incident Response

* Monitor, triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts generated from MDR, SIEM, endpoint protection, cloud security, and identity security platforms.
* Conduct incident investigations, collect forensic evidence, analyze root causes, and document findings in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate containment, remediation, recovery, and communication activities related to cybersecurity incidents.
* Develop recommendations to improve security controls, monitoring capabilities, and response procedures based on incident findings.
* Assist with proactive threat hunting and security investigations.
* Maintain incident response documentation, playbooks, procedures, and lessons learned.

Vulnerability Management

* Own the vulnerability management lifecycle including identification, prioritization, remediation tracking, validation, risk acceptance, and reporting.
* Coordinate with IT, Engineering, and system owners to ensure timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
* Facilitate vulnerability review meetings and track remediation performance against established targets.
* Analyze vulnerability trends and provide risk-based recommendations to management.
* Assist with implementation of security hardening recommendations across endpoints, servers, cloud services, applications, and network infrastructure.

Security Projects & Continuous Improvement

jobs.description:
**Safety & Emergency Preparedness****Progra****m Manager**

  

**The Center for Elders' Independence**is a PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the elderly) organization that uses an interdisciplinary team approach to care planning and care implementation for the purpose of providing high quality, affordable, integrated health care services to the elderly, including an Adult Day Health Center, and promoting autonomy, quality of life and the ability of individuals to live in their communities.

**The Position**: Under the direction of the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), the Safety & Emergency Preparedness, Program Manager is responsible for building, implementing, and continuously improving safety across all PACE care settings for participants, staff, visitors, volunteers and contracted providers. Specifically, this role will oversee initiatives across all CEI facilities including PACE center facilities, clinics, transportation, and home care. This role leads proactive hazard identification, incident response, and safety education, in alignment with OSHA, CMS, state, and local health and safety regulations. The Safety & Emergency Preparedness Program Manager champions a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the organization to support zero harm and high reliability.

The annual pay range for the Safety & Emergency Preparedness, Program Manager position at Center for Elders' Independence is $102,302 to $153,454. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI's annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Collaborate with the CHRO and other leaders to identify, design, implement, and provide training on a standardized emergency management structure, such as the Hospital Incident Command System (HICS) or a protocol aligned with the National Incident Management System (NIMS), to ensure a coordinated and effective organizational response to emergencies.
* Ensure the effective deployment of emergency information through Everbridge.
* Lead the ongoing development, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement of CEI's comprehensive Safety Program.
* Conduct regular Environment of Care (EOC) rounds, and other preparedness activities, across all PACE locations—clinical and non-clinical—to proactively identify and mitigate safety risks.
* Chair the Safety Committee and actively participate in other internal committees, contributing to ongoing audit preparedness (e.g., CMS, DHCS).
* Assess potential hazards to participants and staff and develop corrective action plans to address and prevent incidents.
* Establish and enforce safety policies and procedures that ensure full compliance with OSHA, CMS, DHCS, CDPH, and other relevant regulatory bodies.
* Investigate safety incidents, prepare detailed reports with findings and lead root cause analyses and corrective action planning.
* Use technology tools including incident reporting platform, audit checklists, CAP tracker, dashboard/BI tools, LMS training platforms, and document control software.
* Design and deliver engaging safety training programs for staff, covering topics such as infection control, hazard communication, emergency response, and incident command.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with departments to uphold safety standards across all care environments, including facilities, transportation, and home care.
* Direct the Emergency Preparedness Program, ensuring organizational readiness for a range of emergency scenarios.
* Maintain accurate documentation of safety audits, incident investigations, and regulatory inspections.

  

**REQUIRED** **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Health & Safety, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
* Minimum of three years' experience in healthcare safety, emergency management, or risk management.
* In-depth knowledge of OSHA, CMS, and state safety regulations, particularly in elder care or outpatient settings.
* Strong oral and written communication, training, and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with risk management principles and incident command systems.

  

**PREFERED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in a PACE organization, long-term care, or home health environment.
* Certified Healthcare Safety Professional (CHSP).
* OSHA 30-Hour – General Industry certification.

-------------------

**About ClearConnect Solutions**

At ClearConnect Solutions, an Acrisure company, we believe there’s a story in your data, and we help our clients see it. We specialize in cutting-edge, data-driven technology solutions for fleet insurers, underwriters, and policyholders. From real-time risk score monitoring, automated Motor Vehicle Report (MVR) services, and screening platforms to advanced telematics and route optimization, our software empowers the transportation and insurance industries to mitigate risk, streamline compliance, and build safer driver workforces.

We are expanding our software development capabilities and looking for a dynamic Product Owner / Project Manager to bridge the gap between business strategy and agile execution.

**Job Summary**

The Product Owner / Project Manager serves a dual-purpose role, driving product vision, backlog, and requirements while keeping the software development team aligned, unblocked, and on schedule. This role owns the product lifecycle from concept through deployment for data and risk-management platforms, leads agile ceremonies, develops precise user stories, and partners with engineering, QA, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable features for the fleet and insurance sectors.

**Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership & Requirements Engineering**

* Backlog Management: Own, prioritize, and groom the product backlog, ensuring user stories align with strategic business goals and product roadmaps.
* Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with internal stakeholders, data analysts, and industry experts to translate complex data workflows, including MVR automation, telematics, and risk scoring, into clear, actionable technical requirements.
* User Story Creation: Write detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications that provide clear direction for software developers and QA teams.
* Product Roadmap Support: Assist leadership in defining release scopes, tracking milestones, and aligning software releases with company growth objectives.

Project Management & Scrum Leadership

* Scrum Ceremonies: Lead agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Sprint Execution & Delivery: Manage sprint velocity, remove blockers, and help the engineering team deliver high-quality code on schedule.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary communication conduit between technical teams and business stakeholders, manage expectations, and provide transparent project-status updates.
* Process Improvement: Continuously optimize agile workflows, tools, and documentation practices to improve team efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Project Manager, or Scrum Master in an Agile software development environment.
* Strong familiarity with software development life cycles (SDLC), API integrations, and data-heavy platforms.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business language and business needs into technical requirements.
* Analytical mindset and comfort working with complex data systems, risk models, and compliance workflows to define logical product solutions.
* Proficiency with agile project management and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or an equivalent agile certification.
* Experience with SaaS, InsurTech, FinTech, fleet-management technology, or related data-driven platforms.
* Experience supporting products involving MVR automation, telematics, risk scoring, screening, compliance, or route optimization.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
* An opportunity to shape innovative software products in the rapidly evolving InsurTech and fleet-safety space.
* A collaborative, data-driven culture that values continuous learning and professional growth.

new_jobs.title: Senior GTM Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Senior GTM Intelligence Analyst**

**Reports to:** Senior Manager, Data Analysis & Reporting

**Location:** Remote (U.S.), occasional travel

**Turn data into decisions.**

Every company has data. Very few have intelligence.

As Senior GTM Intelligence Analyst, you'll help our leadership team understand what's really happening across the business. You'll connect signals across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to identify the trends that matter, explain why they're happening, and recommend what we should do next.

When leaders ask, *Why are win rates declining? Why are renewals improving in one segment but not another? Which investments are actually driving growth?* you're the person who brings the answer, not just the dashboard.

You'll build a single, trusted view of our commercial business across decades of acquisitions and multiple product lines, giving executives the confidence to make faster, better decisions.

This role helps build and scale the business intelligence layer behind our go-to-market strategy and tells the story of our business.

**What you'll do**

**Build the business intelligence layer.** Partner with GTM Operations, Finance, and Data teams to define, document, and improve the metrics that run the business from pipeline, conversion, attainment, and forecast accuracy to retention, NRR, customer health, and expansion. Contribute to a consistent, trusted language for commercial performance across business units.

**Deliver executive insights.** Produce the analysis that leaders rely on to understand commercial performance, diagnose issues, evaluate opportunities, and prioritize investments. Connect the dots across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to tell one coherent business story.

**Drive diagnostic analytics.** Go beyond reporting to uncover root causes, quantify business impact, and recommend actions. You'll spend as much time investigating why performance changed as you will measuring what changed.

**Partner on the data foundation.** Work closely with Data Engineering and GTM operations teams to ensure Salesforce, product usage, support, marketing, billing, and financial data are modeled for trusted, scalable analysis and self-service.

**Advance AI-powered intelligence.** Evaluate emerging AI-enabled analytics capabilities and help identify practical use cases for the GTM Intelligence function. Your goal is simple: help leaders spend less time searching for answers and more time acting on them.

**Who you are**

* 4+ years in GTM, Revenue, Customer Success, or Business Analytics within a B2B SaaS organization.
* Expert SQL skills and hands-on experience with modern BI platforms such as Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, or similar.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce data model and experience integrating multiple operational data sources into meaningful business insights.
* Passionate about metric governance and data quality because you know great decisions begin with trusted numbers.
* Naturally curious and energized by solving ambiguous business problems.
* Able to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations that executives can quickly understand and act on.
* Excited by the emergence of AI-native analytics platforms and eager to rethink how business intelligence is delivered.

**Why this role is different**

We're building a modern GTM Intelligence function that combines a strong data foundation, AI-powered analytics, and thoughtful business analysis to improve decision making across the company. You'll play a foundational role in defining our metrics, shaping executive insights, and helping leaders make faster, better-informed decisions. As the function evolves, you'll have the opportunity to grow with it and help define what it becomes.

Position Overview:

**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for an experienced **Business Analyst – Procure-to-Pay** to help drive the transformation, standardization and continuous improvement of our end-to-end P2P processes and supporting systems.

**Your Mission**
================

As part of the **Finance Technology** team, you will act as a **business partner to Procurement, Finance and Business stakeholders**, with the ability to understand the underlying business objective, challenge existing ways of working, identify opportunities for simplification and automation, and translate business needs into efficient, scalable processes and system solutions.

Your role covers the **end-to-end P2P landscape**, from sourcing and contract lifecycle management through purchase requisitions, purchase orders, supplier invoicing, expense management, approvals, accruals and payment readiness, across applications including Workday Financials, Workday Procurement, Concur and CLM.

You will work at the **intersection of Business, Finance and IS**, ensuring that technology enables the right business processes rather than simply reproducing existing ways of working.

**We are not looking for a purely technical application specialist**. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Procure-to-Pay, Procurement and Finance transformation, ERP or business applications, combined with the ability to understand and navigate a complex multi-system environment. Knowledge of Workday Procurement, Concur or CLM is a strong advantage, but a strong P2P / Finance Systems profile with experience on other ERP or enterprise platforms will also be considered.

Responsibilities:

* **Act as a Business Partner for Procure-to-Pay**

* Develop a strong understanding of the company's business model, Procurement and Finance processes and end-to-end P2P operating model.
* Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal and Business stakeholders to understand their objectives, challenges and pain points.
* **Challenge existing processes, requirements and assumptions**, rather than simply translating them into system specifications.
* Ask the right questions to distinguish between a genuine business need, an existing practice and a historical system limitation.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate and improve processes across purchasing, supplier invoice management, expenses and contract lifecycle management.
* Recommend pragmatic solutions that balance business value, user experience, scalability, compliance and technical constraints.
* Help stakeholders move from a **“what we do today”** mindset to a **“what should the target process be?”**

* **Own P2P Process Analysis & Design**

* Map and document current-state and target-state P2P processes.
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, manual activities, controls and risks.
* Define clear process ownership, responsibilities and hand-offs between Procurement, Finance, Legal, Business teams and IS.
* Design target processes in collaboration with Procurement, Finance and Business stakeholders.
* Ensure consistency and appropriate standardization across countries, entities and business units.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process simplification across requisitioning, approvals, receiving, invoicing, expenses and contract management.
* Contribute to the evolution of the Finance Technology operating model and P2P roadmap.
* **Translate Business Needs into Effective Solutions**

* Lead functional analysis from business problem to solution.
* Gather business needs, but **challenge and refine them before translating them into requirements**.
* Define business rules, functional requirements, data requirements, approval rules, controls and acceptance criteria.
* Assess alternative solutions and make recommendations to stakeholders.
* Work closely with IS architects, application owners and integration teams to validate solution feasibility.
* Ensure that proposed solutions address the **end-to-end business process**, rather than optimizing a single application in isolation.
* Assess upstream and downstream impacts before changes are implemented, including procurement operations, accounting, supplier management, compliance and reporting.
* **Own the End-to-End P2P Systems Perspective**
* The role will cover the interaction between the key applications supporting P2P, including:

**CLM Workday Procurement Concur Workday Financials**

* The candidate will:
  + Understand how business processes and data flow across the application landscape.
  + Identify dependencies and impacts between applications.
  + Define functional requirements for system changes and integrations.

Overview:

**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for an experienced **Business Analyst – Procure-to-Pay** to help drive the transformation, standardization and continuous improvement of our end-to-end P2P processes and supporting systems.

**Your Mission**
================

As part of the **Finance Technology** team, you will act as a **business partner to Procurement, Finance and Business stakeholders**, with the ability to understand the underlying business objective, challenge existing ways of working, identify opportunities for simplification and automation, and translate business needs into efficient, scalable processes and system solutions.

Your role covers the **end-to-end P2P landscape**, from sourcing and contract lifecycle management through purchase requisitions, purchase orders, supplier invoicing, expense management, approvals, accruals and payment readiness, across applications including Workday Financials, Workday Procurement, Concur and CLM.

You will work at the **intersection of Business, Finance and IS**, ensuring that technology enables the right business processes rather than simply reproducing existing ways of working.

**We are not looking for a purely technical application specialist**. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Procure-to-Pay, Procurement and Finance transformation, ERP or business applications, combined with the ability to understand and navigate a complex multi-system environment. Knowledge of Workday Procurement, Concur or CLM is a strong advantage, but a strong P2P / Finance Systems profile with experience on other ERP or enterprise platforms will also be considered.

new_jobs.title: Safety & Emergency Preparedness Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Safety & Emergency Preparedness****Progra****m Manager**

  

**The Center for Elders' Independence**is a PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the elderly) organization that uses an interdisciplinary team approach to care planning and care implementation for the purpose of providing high quality, affordable, integrated health care services to the elderly, including an Adult Day Health Center, and promoting autonomy, quality of life and the ability of individuals to live in their communities.

**The Position**: Under the direction of the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), the Safety & Emergency Preparedness, Program Manager is responsible for building, implementing, and continuously improving safety across all PACE care settings for participants, staff, visitors, volunteers and contracted providers. Specifically, this role will oversee initiatives across all CEI facilities including PACE center facilities, clinics, transportation, and home care. This role leads proactive hazard identification, incident response, and safety education, in alignment with OSHA, CMS, state, and local health and safety regulations. The Safety & Emergency Preparedness Program Manager champions a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the organization to support zero harm and high reliability.

The annual pay range for the Safety & Emergency Preparedness, Program Manager position at Center for Elders' Independence is $102,302 to $153,454. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI's annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Collaborate with the CHRO and other leaders to identify, design, implement, and provide training on a standardized emergency management structure, such as the Hospital Incident Command System (HICS) or a protocol aligned with the National Incident Management System (NIMS), to ensure a coordinated and effective organizational response to emergencies.
* Ensure the effective deployment of emergency information through Everbridge.
* Lead the ongoing development, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement of CEI's comprehensive Safety Program.
* Conduct regular Environment of Care (EOC) rounds, and other preparedness activities, across all PACE locations—clinical and non-clinical—to proactively identify and mitigate safety risks.
* Chair the Safety Committee and actively participate in other internal committees, contributing to ongoing audit preparedness (e.g., CMS, DHCS).
* Assess potential hazards to participants and staff and develop corrective action plans to address and prevent incidents.
* Establish and enforce safety policies and procedures that ensure full compliance with OSHA, CMS, DHCS, CDPH, and other relevant regulatory bodies.
* Investigate safety incidents, prepare detailed reports with findings and lead root cause analyses and corrective action planning.
* Use technology tools including incident reporting platform, audit checklists, CAP tracker, dashboard/BI tools, LMS training platforms, and document control software.
* Design and deliver engaging safety training programs for staff, covering topics such as infection control, hazard communication, emergency response, and incident command.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with departments to uphold safety standards across all care environments, including facilities, transportation, and home care.
* Direct the Emergency Preparedness Program, ensuring organizational readiness for a range of emergency scenarios.
* Maintain accurate documentation of safety audits, incident investigations, and regulatory inspections.

  

**REQUIRED** **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Health & Safety, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
* Minimum of three years' experience in healthcare safety, emergency management, or risk management.
* In-depth knowledge of OSHA, CMS, and state safety regulations, particularly in elder care or outpatient settings.
* Strong oral and written communication, training, and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with risk management principles and incident command systems.

  

**PREFERED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in a PACE organization, long-term care, or home health environment.
* Certified Healthcare Safety Professional (CHSP).
* OSHA 30-Hour – General Industry certification.

  

The above job description is intended to communicate the general function of the above-mentioned position and by no means shall be considered an exhaustive or complete outline of the specific tasks and functions that will be required. CEI reserves the right to change job descriptions, site assignments, and or work hours as required by the needs of the program. All employees are expected to perform their duties within their ability as required by the job and/or as requested by management.

**Description**

  

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

As the Printed Circuit Board (PCB) industry undergoes a major renaissance focused on advanced interconnect technology, miniaturization, and high-performance applications across global markets, Sanmina’s PCB division is leading the evolution. The Sales Operations Analyst plays a pivotal role in empowering our Worldwide Sales organization, serving as a key analytical engine to drive growth, data accuracy, and strategic decision-making. Reporting to the SVP, Global Sales PCB Division, you will partner closely with sales leaders to transform complex data into actionable insights, optimize forecasting, and ensure the highest standards of data quality and targeted reporting.

Nature of Duties & Responsibilities

* Sales Data Intelligence & Reporting: Compile, analyze, and report comprehensive sales data segmented by OEM, market, facility, and advanced technology platforms.
* Performance Evaluation & Variance Analysis: Evaluate sales performance rigorously, providing detailed variance analysis by customer, region, and individual sales representatives, comparing actuals against bookings, revenue budgets, and forecasts.
* Strategic Forecasting: Collaborate directly with sales teams to forecast future bookings and revenue streams with high precision.
* Sales Planning & Objectives: Contribute meaningfully to the development of annual and long-term strategic sales plans and objectives.
* Win/Loss Analytics: Analyze, report, and deliver actionable insights on win/loss ratios broken down by part number, customer, region, location, and sales representative.
* Pricing & Growth Guidance: Translate analytical insights into strategic recommendations to guide future sales plans, market positioning, and pricing structures.
* Major Account Stewardship: Monitor and analyze major account plans for the PCB division to ensure long-term strategic alignment and growth.

Education & Experience

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related analytical field (Master’s degree or MBA is a strong plus).
* 2–4 years of progressive experience in sales analysis, business intelligence, or commercial
* operations within a manufacturing, technology, or fast-paced corporate environment.
* Outstanding Excel skills, with advanced proficiency in data modeling and manipulation.
* Strong familiarity with CRM software and the Microsoft Office suite.
* Exceptional research, analytical, and projection/forecasting skills.
* Outstanding organizational capabilities with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to bridge data and analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to thrive both independently and within cross-functional teams.

**Salary Range(annual): $75,000.00-$92,880.00**

**Actual base pay within this range (determined at the offer stage) will be based on a candidate's years of relevant work experience, education, certifications, and skills, and is just one element of our total rewards package. The total rewards package also includes a variety of benefits, including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business and, depending on the role, may include eligibility for restricted stock unit awards and participation in a discretionary bonus program.**
